verdict.rationale: Obsidian documents a first-party headless Sync client that syncs vaults without the desktop app and is explicitly positioned for CI pipelines, agents, and automated workflows. That headless mode covers only vault syncing, not running Obsidian's editor, plugins, or other features without the desktop app. missing for 10: headless execution of the core app or plugins, a documented CLI or automation surface beyond sync, setup or usage depth for the headless client, independent or hands-on corroboration of CI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Obsidian Sync offers a headless client to sync vaults without using the desktop app. Useful for CI pipelines, agents, and automated workflows.
